reason: Every Bing Webmaster JSON response wraps its payload in a WCF {"d": ...} envelope, serializes dates as Microsoft /Date(ms±offset)/ literals, and returns errors unwrapped as {"ErrorCode","Message"}. The generated client passed all three through raw, so every command, the store, and the intelligence layer saw wrapped payloads and opaque dates. Recorded during the 4.31.1 reprint; the layer was verified live in the prior print (phase5 14/14) and preserved via regen-merge Path B.
summary: WCF d-envelope unwrapping plus Microsoft-date normalization wired into client.do().
validated_outcome: Prior print: phase5 live dogfood 14/14 pass. Reprint: preserved file-for-file; merged-tree go build/vet/tests re-run at publish time.
